title: Ad Astra: Star
description: Attempting to land on a star in Ad Astra.
body:
## Description
This addon for [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) introduces the ability to travel to stars (like the Sun). No more worrying about falling into plasma—landing platforms automatically generate beneath you (though excessive gravity may cause your lander to crash!).

Additionally, this mod reintroduces extinguished torches and lanterns, which were removed in Ad Astra! v1.15.15 and later.

## The Solar System:
- Sol.
- Asteroid Belt.

## Alpha Centauri:
- Proxima Centauri.

## Gameplay Notes:
- Crash Risk: Excessive gravity on stars may cause landers to crash upon touchdown.
- No Rocket Launches: You cannot launch rockets from a star’s surface.
- Bug Warning: Extinguished torches/lanterns may have minor issues in this version.
- Compatibility: Requires Ad Astra! v1.15.15 or higher.

## Future Plans:
- More Stars: Proxima Centauri and other stellar dimensions. //Implemented
- Asteroid Belt: Possibly coming in future updates! //Implemented
